contract: surface: Probashi AI public web app (landing, offer check, journey); job: A Bangladeshi migrant worker or family member checks an overseas job offer before paying a broker; primaryAction: Upload or describe an offer and get a green/yellow/red verdict with next steps; direction: Calm authority: editorial Bangla serif headlines, forest green dominant, gold only for achievements, terracotta only for danger; signature motif = verified seal; hierarchy: Verdict and next step first; explanation second; optional paid report last and visually quiet; constraints: Bangla-first, low literacy, cheap Android phones on slow 4G; WCAG 2.2 AA; strict nonce CSP; motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion and never hide content; performanceBudget: On 4x CPU slowdown + slow 4G: JS <= 450 KB, LCP <= 4000 ms, CLS <= 0.1, TBT <= 900 ms per page

accessibility.evidence: axe-core WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A+AA scan of 11 pages at 390x844 and 1280x900 reports zero serious/critical violations (tests/e2e.py axe_scan). Fixed during this pass: step-number colour contrast; earlier passes fixed label-in-name and 24px target size. Focus moves to the verdict heading after a check (asserted). Touch targets 44px. Reduced-motion run asserts hero final state, all flags, verdict and every step are visible.

responsive.evidence: E2E asserts no horizontal scroll on landing, check, cost, agency, plan, privacy, about at 390 and 1280 widths; how-it-works switches from sticky scrollytelling (>=960px) to a stacked list on mobile; mobile menu opens and closes on tap; perf run at 390x844 mobile emulation measured CLS 0 on /, 0.003 on /check, 0 on /journey and /ask after switching fonts to display:optional (was 0.46 with swap).

loading.evidence: Offer check shows staged progress (reading, rules, agency, report) plus skeleton result cards of the final footprint; journey teaser renders a same-size skeleton until local progress loads (no layout shift).

empty.evidence: Journey at 0 points shows level 'Getting started' and the single next step with a CTA; chat shows a greeting and starter question chips; memories list explains how to create the first memory.

error.evidence: Disguised or oversized uploads return plain-language Bangla/English errors with a way to retry (integration tests 415/413); network failure in chat shows a retry message with the 16135 helpline; payment errors are shown inline in the modal.

partial.evidence: When cloud AI is unavailable the check returns the rule-engine verdict marked 'Rule-based check' and on-device OCR fills the form (E2E [ocr] checks); the paid report explains it needs AI and points back to the free result.

success.evidence: Verdict with drawn seal, score explained in words, red flags by severity, cost table, next steps, share to family; milestone celebration only on positive moments (asserted no toast on danger).

permission.evidence: Microphone denial shows 'Allow microphone access' and typing remains available; account and memories redirect to login when signed out (E2E); progress is kept on-device for guests with a prompt to log in.

renderedEvidence.observation: Hero: seal eyebrow, two-line Bangla headline with terracotta emphasis, magnetic primary CTA, GSAP offer-scan demo card with flags and danger ring; sources strip; readiness teaser; sticky how-it-works with Hairline figure and scroll progress line.
Single column; CTAs stacked full-width-ish at 54px; demo card below the fold-safe copy; how-it-works as stacked cards; no horizontal scroll.
Uploaded offer letter preview, optional fields collapsed, verdict with drawn danger seal and explained score, flags with Bangla severity badges, calm optional report card.
Sticky submit button, collapsed optional details, verdict focused after check, cost table with Bangla-first labels.
Readiness ring at 55 'Prepared', next-step card, three phases with per-phase meters, phase 2 unlocked, protect-others share completed.
Hairline figure hidden under 640px so steps are above the fold; phases stack; toasts anchored bottom-left away from results.

knownLimits: Live AI/OCR quality with real Claude/OpenAI keys is untested in this environment (npm run test:live).
Bangla on-device OCR model is installed but only an English letter was verified (no Bangla font to render a test image here).
Visual quality was judged by the builder plus one independent agent audit earlier; no user testing with migrant workers yet.
